panels.title: Primary Experiment Metrics (Daily by Arm) — ADR-030

panels.description: Primary metric (ADR-030): sum(watched_ms) / uniqMerge(viewers) per day and arm over all surfaces.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime(day) AS time, sum(watched_ms) / nullIf(uniqMerge(viewers), 0) AS "reco (Treatment)" FROM winkey.reco_ab_daily WHERE day >= toDate($__fromTime) AND day <= toDate($__toTime) AND reco_variant = 'reco' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

SELECT toDateTime(day) AS time, sum(watched_ms) / nullIf(uniqMerge(viewers), 0) AS "control" FROM winkey.reco_ab_daily WHERE day >= toDate($__fromTime) AND day <= toDate($__toTime) AND reco_variant = 'control' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Watch Time per Active Viewer

panels.description: Daily unique signed-in viewers per A/B arm: uniqMerge(viewers). ADR-030 decision rule requires >= 200 active viewers per arm for >= 14 days.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime(day) AS time, uniqMerge(viewers) AS "reco (Treatment)" FROM winkey.reco_ab_daily WHERE day >= toDate($__fromTime) AND day <= toDate($__toTime) AND reco_variant = 'reco' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

SELECT toDateTime(day) AS time, uniqMerge(viewers) AS "control" FROM winkey.reco_ab_daily WHERE day >= toDate($__fromTime) AND day <= toDate($__toTime) AND reco_variant = 'control' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Active Viewers per Arm (Target >= 200)

panels.description: Secondary metric (ADR-030): Playback starts initiated from surface=for_you per active viewer: sumIf(starts, surface = 'for_you') / uniqMerge(viewers).

targets.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime(day) AS time, sumIf(starts, surface = 'for_you') / nullIf(uniqMerge(viewers), 0) AS "reco (Treatment)" FROM winkey.reco_ab_daily WHERE day >= toDate($__fromTime) AND day <= toDate($__toTime) AND reco_variant = 'reco' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

SELECT toDateTime(day) AS time, sumIf(starts, surface = 'for_you') / nullIf(uniqMerge(viewers), 0) AS "control" FROM winkey.reco_ab_daily WHERE day >= toDate($__fromTime) AND day <= toDate($__toTime) AND reco_variant = 'control' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Starts from surface=for_you per Active Viewer

panels.description: Secondary metric (ADR-030): Proportion of watch time coming from surface=for_you by arm: sumIf(watched_ms, surface = 'for_you') / sum(watched_ms).

targets.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime(day) AS time, sumIf(watched_ms, surface = 'for_you' AND reco_variant = 'reco') / nullIf(sumIf(watched_ms, reco_variant = 'reco'), 0) AS "reco (Treatment)" FROM winkey.reco_ab_daily WHERE day >= toDate($__fromTime) AND day <= toDate($__toTime) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

SELECT toDateTime(day) AS time, sumIf(watched_ms, surface = 'for_you' AND reco_variant = 'control') / nullIf(sumIf(watched_ms, reco_variant = 'control'), 0) AS "control" FROM winkey.reco_ab_daily WHERE day >= toDate($__fromTime) AND day <= toDate($__toTime) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: for_you Watch Time Share by Arm

panels.description: Daily watch time breakdown across all playback origin surfaces (ADR-030).

targets.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime(day) AS time, sumIf(watched_ms, surface = 'for_you') AS "for_you", sumIf(watched_ms, surface = 'latest') AS "latest", sumIf(watched_ms, surface = 'trending') AS "trending", sumIf(watched_ms, surface = 'up_next') AS "up_next", sumIf(watched_ms, surface = 'search') AS "search", sumIf(watched_ms, surface = 'subscriptions') AS "subscriptions", sumIf(watched_ms, surface = 'channel') AS "channel", sumIf(watched_ms, surface = 'playlist') AS "playlist", sumIf(watched_ms, surface NOT IN ('for_you', 'latest', 'trending', 'up_next', 'search', 'subscriptions', 'channel', 'playlist')) AS "other" FROM winkey.reco_ab_daily WHERE day >= toDate($__fromTime) AND day <= toDate($__toTime) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Share of Watch Time by Surface (Stacked %)

panels.description: Summary of active viewers, total watch time, watch time per viewer, and for_you metrics across the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT reco_variant AS "Arm", uniqMerge(viewers) AS "Active Viewers", round(sum(watched_ms) / 60000, 1) AS "Total Watch Time (min)", round((sum(watched_ms) / nullIf(uniqMerge(viewers), 0)) / 60000, 2) AS "Watch Time / Viewer (min)", round(sumIf(starts, surface = 'for_you') / nullIf(uniqMerge(viewers), 0), 2) AS "for_you Starts / Viewer", round(sumIf(watched_ms, surface = 'for_you') / nullIf(sum(watched_ms), 0) * 100, 2) AS "for_you Watch Time Share (%)" FROM winkey.reco_ab_daily WHERE day >= toDate($__fromTime) AND day <= toDate($__toTime) GROUP BY reco_variant ORDER BY reco_variant
